findings.text: follow-on: the derived-factor machinery (_si_value/_unit_factor, lines 72-84) is never exercised on a non-identity or prefixed pair -- every audited pair is an identity pair (A/A, T/T, Wb/Wb, 1/1, m/m) whose factor is trivially 1.0 -- so a wrong SI scale or prefix table cannot redden the suite; the assertion at line 191 catches only a pair with no hand value, not a wrong factor.
